category_title: Child with profound multiple learning difficulties and visual impairment
scenario_title: Late afternoon distress and story time engagement
minimal_context: The tutor is reading a storybook with sound buttons to Leah while she sits in her wheelchair at 5pm.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is 5pm. Let's sit here in your wheelchair and read the Gruffalo book.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I will press the buttons to make the noises of the animals.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Says the word repetitively while continuing to frown) Ah. Ah.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's keep going with the story. Listen to this part.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Vocalisations gradually become louder and more persistent, demonstrating she is unhappy and uncomfortable in her wheelchair) Ah! Ah!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is 5pm. Let's sit here in your wheelchair and read the Gruffalo book.

STUDENT: (Frowns) Ah.

TUTOR: I will press the buttons to make the noises of the animals.

STUDENT: (Says the word repetitively while continuing to frown) Ah. Ah.

TUTOR: Let's keep going with the story. Listen to this part.

STUDENT: (Vocalisations gradually become louder and more persistent, demonstrating she is unhappy and uncomfortable in her wheelchair) Ah! Ah!

task.content: Settling after a period of distress and engaging in a story session

context.materials: wheelchair, soft 'wedge', 'Gruffalo' book with buttons to make the noises, Sid the puppet
context.social_setting: A member of staff joined Leah and sat next to her on the floor

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Feeling uncomfortable in her wheelchair towards the end of the day
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: frowning and saying 'Ah' repetitively, vocalisations gradually became louder and more persistent

behavior_patterns.condition: When initially moved to the soft wedge
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: she was making fewer vocalisations, although she was still frowning
